title: Delphi per-slice tracker file
description: The frontmatter of a per-slice tracker file, `missions/2026-10-23-foundational-design/tracker/<spec>/<slice>.md` (specs/135 section 14.10). Free prose follows it. The spec and slice come from the path, not the frontmatter. Implemented by `crates/delphi/src/tracker.rs` (`parse_slice_file`); `delphi lint` also checks the path and that a spec with that number exists.

date.description: The day the state was last changed.

title.description: One line: what the slice is.

eval_before.description: A retrieval change (specs/140 section 2.4): the stamp of the `delphi kb eval run` before it. Given with `eval_after`.

eval_after.description: A retrieval change: the stamp of the run after it, on the same golden set. Given with `eval_before`.

eval_waived.description: A change on the retrieval paths that cannot move ranking: one line saying why, in place of the two runs.
